pdf_first_page.front_text_excerpt: Saggi e ricerche Excellence and Innovation in Learning and Teaching (ISSNe 2499-507X), 2022, 2 Doi: 10.3280/exioa2-2022oa15075 Digital Media in Adult and Continuing Education in Germany Lisa Breitschwerdt, Vanessa Beu, Regina Egetenmeyer, Silke Grafe* Abstract Digital media are important elements in the didactic planning a nd design of provisions and programmes in adult and continuing education. Ba sed on questionnaire and interview data from organizations and umbrell a organizations active in adult and continuing education in Germa ny, the article examines how adult educators use digital media and what reasons they give for using them. The article disti nguishes between types of digital media, digital tools, and didactically structured digital media offerings. The analysis shows that educators use digital media in settings combining micro- a nd macrodidactics. Overall, didactic considerations are shifting m ore to the macrodidactic planning level, emphasizing the role of organizat ions and umbrella organizations. This i s accompanied by changing demands o n cooperation between planning staff and instructors. Moreover, the roles of staff expand and diversify with the use of digital media. Keywords: Digital media, adult and continuing education, digitalization, media education, digital tools.
